sentences.en: Never flee from injustice, intolerance, or insanity. Reason must prevail.
sentences.zh: 绝不逃避不公、偏见或疯狂。理智必须占上风。

sentences.en: Whither shall one flee? Where shall I go and abide?
sentences.zh: 往哪里逃？我该去哪里住呢？

sentences.en: If you flee this battle, you will lose some gold.
sentences.zh: 如果你避开这场战斗，就会损失一些金币。
